scripts.build: npm run build -w @salon/shared && npm run build -w @salon/db && npm run build -w @salon/server && npm run build -w @salon/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @salon/server" "npm run dev -w @salon/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @salon/shared && npm run typecheck -w @salon/db && npm run typecheck -w @salon/server && npm run typecheck -w @salon/web
